lines.reference: Super maize meal, SA label (Super Sun, Checkers): 1434 kJ, 7.5 g protein, 1.0 g fat, 75 g glycaemic carbohydrate / 100 g (used 343 kcal / 100 g)
Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat — USDA FDC 171265 (SA full-cream milk 3.3 % fat): 61 kcal / 100 g
Butter, salted — USDA FDC 173410: 717 kcal / 100 g
Sugars, granulated — USDA FDC 169655: 387 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions that change the number: 1 cup super maize meal ≈ 150 g; the 4 cups of water carry no energy; each bowl gets ¼ cup full-cream milk, 1 tsp butter and 1 tsp sugar as step 5 says (honey instead of sugar is about the same). This is a soft breakfast porridge, about 13 % solids. Sanity check: USDA corn grits cooked with water (FDC 171655) is 71 kcal / 100 g at a thicker ~20 % solids; our porridge alone is 45 kcal / 100 g (515 kcal over ~1150 g), so a ~290 g bowl is ~130 kcal before toppings, consistent with a thinner pap. The web search budget ran out before a published per-bowl figure could be found.
